words.definition: Never having happened or been done before
words.sentence: The ____ snowstorm in the desert surprised the camels, since no one had ever seen snow there.
wrongDefinitions: Happening every single day without any change
Planned very carefully a long time ahead
Very small and easy to miss

words.definition: Messy and careless about how you look or keep things
words.sentence: The ____ explorer left muddy boots, crumbs and crumpled maps scattered all over the tent floor.
wrongDefinitions: Moving very slowly and carefully
Kind and gentle to everyone you meet
Very proud of the place you live

words.definition: Easy to hurt or harm because it is not well protected
words.sentence: Without its hard shell, the hermit crab is ____ to hungry seagulls, so it hurries to find a new one.
wrongDefinitions: Very strong and hard to damage
Able to change color to hide
Covered in sharp spikes or thorns

words.definition: Something that pulls attention away from something else
words.sentence: While one monkey made a noisy ____, the others sneaked into the tent and grabbed the bananas.
wrongDefinitions: A tool used for digging deep holes
A promise you make to a friend
A long list of rules to follow

words.definition: Kind and gentle, causing as little pain as possible
words.sentence: The wildlife park uses ____ traps that catch lost foxes without hurting them, then sets them free outside.
wrongDefinitions: Very funny and full of silly jokes
Damp and sticky like hot summer air
Very loud and hard to ignore

words.definition: To pretend to feel or be something
words.sentence: When a fox comes near, the clever opossum will ____ death by lying perfectly still with its tongue out.
wrongDefinitions: To rule over a kingdom as king or queen
To shout loudly for help
To dig a tunnel underground

words.definition: Sad and teary in a silly, overly emotional way
words.sentence: After three bowls of ice cream, Uncle Leo grew ____ and sobbed while singing sad songs about his old dog.
wrongDefinitions: Calm and sensible about every problem
Covered in thick, sticky mud
Brave and ready for any adventure

words.definition: A puzzling situation where you are not sure what to do
words.sentence: The explorer was in a ____: cross the shaky bridge or take the long trail through bear country?
wrongDefinitions: A deep pit where people dig out stone
A loud argument between two friends
A large flock of singing birds

words.definition: The time a baby grows inside its mother before birth
words.sentence: An elephant's ____ lasts nearly two years, so the herd waits a long time for each new calf.
wrongDefinitions: Moving your hands to show what you mean
The time an animal sleeps through winter
A long trip animals take each season

words.definition: An imaginary place where life is scary, unfair and miserable
words.sentence: In the book, robots rule a gray ____ where nobody may laugh, play outside or eat dessert.
wrongDefinitions: A perfect, happy world where everyone gets along
A sandy desert with no water at all
A map showing mountains and rivers

words.definition: Fate, or something that seems meant to happen
words.sentence: Finding the lost puppy on the very day we wished for a pet felt like ____ to my whole family.
wrongDefinitions: A small kiss on the cheek
A carpet woven by hand
A careful plan made in secret

words.definition: Using fancy, showy words to sound important
words.sentence: The ____ parrot squawked, 'Behold my magnificent, splendiferous feathers!' instead of just saying, 'Hello there!'
wrongDefinitions: Very large and heavy, like a boulder
Quiet and shy around new people
Having to do with grandparents and family
